name: Pope Leo IX
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1049 to 1054
contribution: The Bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 12 February 1049 to his death in 1054.

checks.lead: Pope Leo IX (Italian: Leone IX, German: Leo IX.; born Bruno von Egisheim-Dagsburg; 21 June 1002 – 19 April 1054) was the Bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 12 February 1049 to his death in 1054. Leo IX is considered to be one of the most historically significant popes of the Middle Ages; he was instrumental in the precipitation of the Great Schism of 1054, considered the turning point in which the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Churches formally separated.
